# Slider — sukuna-ui

> Pick a number from a range by dragging or with the keyboard.

- **Package:** `sukuna-ui` — `bun add sukuna-ui` (or `npm i sukuna-ui`)
- **Import:** `import { Slider } from 'sukuna-ui'`
- **Styles:** `@import "sukuna-ui/theme.css"` (Tailwind v4) or `import "sukuna-ui/styles.css"` (no Tailwind) — see [Getting started](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/arielplas/sukuna-ui/main/llms.txt)
- **Source:** https://github.com/arielplas/sukuna-ui/tree/main/src/components/slider · **Spec:** https://github.com/arielplas/sukuna-ui/blob/main/docs/component-slider.md

## Purpose

Pick a number from a range by dragging or with the keyboard.

## API

```ts
export interface SliderProps {
  value?: number
  defaultValue?: number
  onValueChange?: (value: number) => void
  min?: number     // default 0
  max?: number     // default 100
  step?: number    // default 1
  disabled?: boolean
  className?: string
  'aria-label'?: string
}
```

## Variants & tokens

track: `h-1.5 w-full rounded-pill bg-surface-2`; indicator: `bg-accent rounded-pill` (Base UI sizes
it); thumb: `size-4 rounded-full bg-text border border-line focus-visible:ring-2
focus-visible:ring-accent-glow`; disabled → `opacity-45`.

## States

default · dragging · focus-visible ring on thumb · disabled.

## Accessibility

- [ ] Thumb exposes `role="slider"` + `aria-valuenow/min/max` (Base UI); give an `aria-label`.
- [ ] Arrow keys adjust by `step`; Home/End jump to min/max.
- [ ] Disabled sliders are not focusable.
